label: RSA private key header
text:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA...
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

label: OpenSSH private key
text:

b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAA...

label: encrypted PKCS#8 block
text:
-----BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIFHDBOBgkqhkiG9w0BBQ0wQTApBgkqhkiG9w0BBQwwHAQIEXAMPLEEXAMPLE
-----END ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----

label: JSON-escaped PKCS#8 block: the span covers the body, not just the header
prose with punctuation between the markers: the span stays on the header
text:
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
The rest of this note is unrelated text.
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----

label: letters-and-spaces prose between the markers: spaces inside a body line end the tail
text:
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
the rest of this note is unrelated text
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----

label: indented key in a YAML block scalar keeps its full span
text:
key: |
  -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
  MIIBVQIBADANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAASCAT8wggE7AgEAAkEAu1SU1LfVLPHCozMx
  AAAA==
  -----END PRIVATE KEY-----

label: key with newlines collapsed to spaces keeps its full span
END marker with a different qualifier does not close the block
legacy encrypted PEM headers stay inside the span
text:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED
DEK-Info: AES-128-CBC,0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF

MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
